name: Zip World
summary: Sydney budget dialup ISP (Zip World Pty Ltd), formed April 1998 from the merger of Zip Internet Professionals and World Reach (both founded 1995); one of Sydney's largest private ISPs (~10,000 users); acquired by Pacific Internet June 1999.

events.details: Zip Internet Professionals & World Reach each founded 1995.
Acquired by Pacific Internet (agreement announced 14 Jun 1999).
